USNF 26 (Sodium Cetostearyl Sulfate). A mixture of sodium cetyl sulfate (C16H33NaSO4 = 344.5) and sodium stearyl sulfate (C18H37NaSO4 = 372.5). It contains not less than 40% of sodium cetyl sulfate and the sum of the sodium cetyl sulfate content and sodium stearyl sulfate content is not less than 90%, both contents calculated on the anhydrous basis. A white or pale yellow, amor- phous or crystalline powder. Soluble in hot water giving an opal- escent solution; practically insoluble in cold water; partly soluble in alcohol. Profile Sodium cetostearyl sulfate is an anionic emulsifying agent. It is used as a detergent and wetting agent. Sodium Cocoyl Isetionate Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate. Кокоил Изетионат Натрия CAS — 61789-32-0. Profile Sodium cocoyl isetionate is the sodium salt of a sulfonated ester of coconut oil fatty acids. It is an anionic surfactant used as a soap substitute. Sodium cocoyl sarcosinate has been used similarly.
